privacy_policy_subtitle: How we collect, use, and protect your personal information
privacy_intro_text: Sky eSims ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our website and mobile application to purchase and manage eSIM services.
privacy_collect_intro: We collect information that you provide directly to us, including:
privacy_collect_item1: Personal identification information (name, email address, phone number)
privacy_collect_item2: Billing information and payment details (processed securely through our payment provider)
privacy_collect_item3: Device information required for eSIM activation (device model, IMEI)
privacy_collect_item4: Usage data related to your eSIM service
privacy_use_intro: We use the information we collect to:
privacy_use_item1: Process and fulfill your eSIM purchases
privacy_use_item2: Activate and manage your eSIM profiles
privacy_use_item3: Provide customer support and respond to inquiries
privacy_use_item4: Send important service updates and notifications
privacy_use_item5: Improve our services and develop new features
privacy_sharing_intro: We may share your information with:
privacy_sharing_item1: Mobile network operators necessary to provide eSIM services
privacy_sharing_item3: Service providers who assist in operating our platform
privacy_security_text: We implement appropriate technical and organizational security measures to protect your personal information against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. Your payment information is encrypted and processed through secure payment gateways.
privacy_rights_item1: Access and receive a copy of your personal data
privacy_rights_item3: Request deletion of your personal data
privacy_cookies_text: We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your browsing experience, analyze site traffic, and understand where our visitors come from. You can control cookie settings through your browser preferences.
privacy_contact_text: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at:

refund_subtitle: Our commitment to fair and transparent refund practices
refund_overview_text: At Sky eSims, we strive to provide excellent service and customer satisfaction. This policy outlines the conditions under which refunds may be issued for our eSIM products.
refund_digital_text: eSIMs are digital products delivered electronically. Unlike physical goods, once an eSIM profile has been installed or activated on your device, it cannot be returned or resold. Please verify device compatibility and plan details before purchase.
refund_eligibility_intro: You may be eligible for a refund in the following circumstances:
refund_eligibility_item1: Technical issues on our end that prevent eSIM delivery or activation
refund_eligibility_item2: Duplicate purchase made in error (same eSIM purchased twice)
refund_eligibility_item3: eSIM not installed or activated within 30 days of purchase
refund_eligibility_item4: Service not available in the destination country as advertised
refund_nonrefundable_intro: Refunds will not be issued in the following cases:
refund_nonrefundable_item1: eSIM has been installed and activated on your device
refund_nonrefundable_item2: Data has been consumed from the eSIM plan
refund_nonrefundable_item3: Device is not eSIM-compatible or is carrier-locked
refund_process_intro: To request a refund, please follow these steps:
refund_process_step1: Contact our support team at support@skyesims.com within 7 days of purchase
refund_process_step2: Provide your order number and reason for the refund request
refund_process_step3: Our team will review your request within 2-3 business days
refund_process_step4: If approved, refunds will be processed to the original payment method
refund_timeline_text: Once approved, refunds are typically processed within 5-10 business days. The time for the refund to appear in your account depends on your payment provider and may take an additional 3-5 business days.
refund_cancellation_item1: Orders can be cancelled before the eSIM is installed on your device
refund_cancellation_item2: To cancel, contact support immediately after placing your order
refund_cancellation_item3: Once an eSIM is installed, cancellation is not possible
refund_disputes_text: If you have a billing dispute, please contact our support team before initiating a chargeback with your payment provider. We are committed to resolving issues fairly and promptly. Unauthorized chargebacks may result in account suspension.
refund_contact_text: For refund requests or questions about this policy, please contact our support team:
